tha-ap189:3.1: niviṭṭhāssa → niviṭṭhassa (sya-all); niviṭṭhāya (pts) | saddhāniviṭṭhāssa → niviṭṭhassaṁ (bj: sīmu)
tha-ap189:4.4: abyāpajjaṁ → abyāpajjhaṁ (sya-all, pts) | avyāpajjhaṁ → abyāpajjaṁ (machasaṁ); avyāpajjaṁ (bj note) | abyāpajjaṁ → abyāpajjhaṁ (cck: syā.); appamāṇaṁ (cck: itivuttake 83)
tha-ap189:6.4: puna → deva punappunaṁ (bj: machasaṁ) | punappunaṁ → devapuraṁ puna (cck: syā.)
tha-ap189:7.1: saṁvego me → saṁviggohaṁ (sya-all); saṁviggo mhi (pts) | āsi → āsiṁ (sya-all, pts) | me → saṁciggohaṁ (bj: syā) | me → saṁviggohaṁ (cck: syā.)
tha-ap189:11.1: upapajjiṁ sa tattheva → upapajjissaṁ tatth eva (pts) | sa → upapajjissaṁ (cck: sī.)
